top_signals.title: Colombian Peso Pares Stellar Rally as Central Bank Steps In
top_signals.summary: The Colombian peso is on track for its biggest drop in three months after the central bank unexpectedly paused rate hikes and announced a program to build up dollar reserves, signaling that the currency’s rally has gone too far.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Tyson Falls on 3Q Results; Bristol-Myers Squibb Surges on Potential Acquisition | Stock Movers
top_signals.summary:
On this episode of Stock Movers:

- Bristol-Myers Squibb (SQB) shares are surging on news AstraZeneca (AZN), whose shares are lower, is exploring an acquisition of Bristol-Myers Squibb.
- Tyson (TSN) shares are dropping after the protein producer reported a 3Q sales shortfall, driven by a 16% reduction in beef sales volume, and cut its total company and beef profit forecasts for the full year. 
- SpaceX (SPCX) shares are moving as investors in the company prepare for its first earnings report as a public company. (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: UBS to Pay $125 Million Over Anti-Money Laundering Violations
top_signals.summary: UBS Financial Services Inc., a subsidiary of UBS Group AG, has agreed to pay $125 million in fines to settle allegations by the US government that it willfully and repeatedly violated anti-money laundering rules.
